evidence_levels.static_image: A single still image was viewed. Establishes appearance only.
evidence_levels.video_frames: Several frames of a clip were viewed at recorded playheads. Establishes state order, not precise easing.
evidence_levels.live_interaction: The interface was operated live and its states observed.
evidence_levels.production_reference: A designer-published sheet or guide. Documents intent, not runtime behaviour.
evidence_levels.source_defined: Behaviour read from source code or a specification, not rendered output.
evidence_levels.documented_text: Text description only (manual, interview). No visual claim allowed.

inspection_methods.browser_view: The image or page was opened and viewed in a browser.
inspection_methods.image_fetched: The image bytes were fetched and viewed; record sha256.
inspection_methods.video_frames: Frames were viewed at recorded playheads.
inspection_methods.user_capture: The user supplied the capture; record sha256.
inspection_methods.unrecorded: Legacy seed data whose inspection method was not recorded. Not accepted for new imports.
